Flush-marker correction
Record: doc-013
Date: 2025-04-26
Collection: Fictional queue-study archive

The proposed correction places the acknowledgement fence after a persisted flush marker. The working hypothesis is that acknowledging buffered records before the marker survives power loss explains the missing stable keys in [[doc-008]].

The proposal is not an installed deployment and does not establish that the defect is fixed. A small replay is described in [[doc-011]], while the full campaign repeat remains pending in [[doc-014]]. The proposal belongs to the Copper Pin archive docket [[doc-012]].
